variant.evidence: YAML model_name: MEGNet; lowercased and underscored per instructions

datasets.evidence: PDF: QM9 molecule dataset (page 10); MP-crystals-2018.6.1 crystal dataset from Materials Project (page 10)

hyperparameters.evidence: PDF: Adam optimizer with initial learning rate 0.001 reduced to 0.0001 (page 10); embedding dimension set to 16 for crystals (page 11); number of MEGNet blocks varies (1-5) depending on property (page 12); radius cutoff of 4 angstroms for crystals (page 10); batch training via single graph assembly (page 10); dense layers with 64 and 32 hidden units (page 8); set2set readout (page 7); early stopping with 500 epochs patience (page 11)

components.evidence: PDF: MEGNet block contains MEGNet layer plus two dense layers (page 7); set2set readout on atomic and bond attributes (page 7); embedding layer for atomic numbers (page 7); residual skip connections (page 7)

head_architecture.evidence: PDF: After readout, concatenated vectors passed through multi-layer perceptrons to generate final output (page 7)

hidden_dimension.evidence: PDF: Dense layers have 64 and 32 hidden units (page 8); embedding dimension is 16 for crystals (page 11)
